title: Cyberpunk 2077

quotes.text: Wake the fuck up, Samurai. We have a city to burn.
We all lap up the last of our fuel eventually. But that hardly means the journey wasn't a joy.
Sony pulled Cyberpunk 2077 from the PlayStation Store for six months after launch over bugs and performance.
Every V line was recorded twice — Gavin Drea and Cherami Leigh, kept apart so neither would imitate the other.
Night City and Adam Smasher both trace back to Mike Pondsmith's 1988 tabletop RPG, Cyberpunk 2020.
Every character creator session ends with a face a full-coverage cyberware helmet will hide for the rest of the game.
Every dumpster, glovebox, and trash pile in Night City gets opened at least once, on principle.
Everyone swears they will romance exactly one person in Night City. Most end up juggling three apartments.

notes: appid 1091500 confirmed via Steam appdetails (type=game, developer/publisher CD PROJEKT RED). Distinguished from Phantom Liberty (2138330, a DLC/expansion), REDmod (2060310, a tool), and Bonus Content (1495710) in the storesearch results — those are not the base game. Johnny Silverhand's 'Wake the f*** up, Samurai' line is cross-verified verbatim across multiple independent sources (Last.fm track title, several YouTube upload titles, TikTok captions) with consistent wording; kept the profanity intact rather than softening it into a paraphrase, since it's the game's single most-quoted line and not a slur. The Delamain line is corroborated word-for-word across two independent quote roundups (TheGamer, a personal blog quoting it with the 'V, a word of advice' lead-in trimmed). Cyberpunk.fandom.com and IMDb both 403/blocked curl and WebFetch, so character-quote sourcing leaned on secondary roundup articles cross-checked against each other rather than the primary wiki.
